en.title: Josh Hartnett Battles Sea Monsters in Netflix's Atmospheric Thriller 'Below'
en.summary: Get ready for a chilling dive into the unknown. Josh Hartnett stars in Netflix's 'Below,' a new limited series that promises deep-sea scares and small-town secrets.
en.body:
The vast, dark expanse of the ocean has always held a certain terror, a place where the unknown can easily become the monstrous. Netflix’s new limited series, **Below**, taps directly into this primal fear, plunging viewers into the frigid waters off the coast of Newfoundland. Creator **Jesse McKeown**, known for his work on **The Umbrella Academy**, crafts a story that is as much about the secrets lurking beneath the waves as it is about the ones buried within a tight-knit community.

At the heart of **Below** is **Josh Hartnett** as a fisherman grappling with a haunted past, forced to confront a terrifying new reality when something ancient and deadly emerges from the deep. He’s joined by **Charlie Heaton** and **Mackenzie Davis**, adding further star power to this atmospheric thriller. The series, which premiered to critical acclaim at TIFF 2026, is a six-episode limited run, meaning every moment is tightly packed with suspense and narrative drive. McKeown and his team have clearly aimed for a show that is both visually stunning and narratively compelling, using the isolated setting to amplify the sense of dread and mystery.

## Coastal Town Under Siege

The premise of **Below** is simple yet potent: a small seaside town finds itself terrorized by a mysterious sea creature. This isn't just a monster movie; it's a deep dive into how a community reacts when faced with an existential threat from the natural world, amplified by the secrets it desperately tries to keep hidden. The interplay between **Hartnett**’s haunted protagonist and the scientific perspective of a marine biologist, as they team up to protect their home, promises a dynamic central relationship. The critical reception so far highlights the show's success in building a supremely atmospheric and suspenseful experience, one that fans of creature features and character-driven mysteries will undoubtedly devour.

## What Fans Can Expect

For fans of **Jesse McKeown**’s previous work, **Below** offers a darker, more intense tone. The series is designed for viewers who appreciate slow-burn tension, well-developed characters, and a healthy dose of the uncanny. The combination of a compelling cast, a creator with a proven track record in the genre space, and a terrifying premise makes **Below** a must-watch for anyone seeking a thrilling escape. The focus on uncovering dark secrets alongside battling a sea monster suggests a narrative that will keep viewers guessing until the very end, making it perfect for a weekend binge.

## Release and Beyond

**Below** made its world premiere at TIFF 2026 on September 10th before its global debut on Netflix on October 8, 2026. With its limited series format, viewers can expect a self-contained, gripping story that offers a complete arc within its six episodes. Keep an eye on official Netflix channels for any post-release discussions or potential companion content, though the nature of a limited series suggests a focus on delivering a singular, impactful experience.
